description: This file defines a custom form choice type class that extends Symfony's ChoiceType, overriding some options and the view building logic for form rendering within the Goteo project.

classes.name: Goteo\Util\Form\Type\ChoiceType
classes.description: A custom form choice type class that overrides default behavior in Symfony forms to tailor the rendering options for choices in the Goteo project.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the block prefix name for this form type, which is 'choice'.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the choice form type, including 'row_class', 'choices_label_escape', and 'wrap_class'.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Prepares the form view with additional variables based on the options, to be used during rendering.
